api.name: ConnectX Orders API
api.purpose: Read-only retrieval of customer and order information from the ConnectX order-management platform.

auth.sensitivity: Credentials are sensitive. They must not appear in prompts, outputs, spreadsheets, screenshots, reports, or presentations.

api.rate_limit: Maximum 100 requests per minute. Exceeding this returns a rate-limit error.
api.pagination: List Orders returns a maximum of 50 records per request. Additional pages must be requested explicitly.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieves detailed information about one specific order.
endpoints.notes: Single-record retrieval by known order number.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieves a list of orders with optional filters. Supports pagination.

query_params.name: start_date
query_params.description: Return orders created on or after this date

query_params.name: end_date
query_params.description: Return orders created on or before this date

query_params.name: customer_id
query_params.description: Return orders belonging to a specific customer

query_params.name: limit
query_params.description: Number of results returned per page (max 50)

endpoints.notes: Use filters to scope results. Pagination required if more than 50 records may be returned.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieves basic information about a specific customer.
endpoints.notes: Only retrieve customer information required for the stated business purpose (data minimization).

endpoints.purpose: Retrieves delivery information for a specific order.
endpoints.notes: Does not include a delivery address field.

descriptions.pending: Order has been created but has not entered processing
descriptions.ready_for_shipping: Order is ready to be dispatched

errors.guidance: Check the request structure and parameters
Check whether the application has permission to access the resource
Check the requested order, customer, or endpoint
Reduce request frequency and retry after an appropriate delay
Record the error and retry later or send for technical review

error_handling_rules: Repeated failed requests should not continue indefinitely.
Rate-limit errors (429) must not result in immediate repeated requests.
Missing records (404) should not cause the complete integration process to fail unnecessarily.
Server-side errors (500) should be recorded for investigation.
503 means pause processing and retry later.
access_rules: Only approved applications may access the API.
Use fictional credentials or mocked API responses for this project.
Only read-only GET operations are included.
Retrieve only the customer information required for the stated business purpose.
Credentials must not be exposed in project outputs.
The project must not create, update, or delete real orders.
A developer must review an integration plan before implementation.
